attempts.input: Two tabs in one browser profile, both on local-test.html. In tab 1: Start from the first Direction, name the project 'Weeks of work A'. Tab 2 opens and renames the project, so tab 1 shows 'Not saving: see the notice at the top of the page'. The owner ignores the notice and keeps working in tab 1: renames to 'Weeks of work A plus edits made while not saving', then switches tabs (I fired a visibilitychange to 'hidden'). Then: Directions, 'Start from' the 4th Direction (no Decisions, so no dialog), rename to 'New project B', switch tabs again.
attempts.observed: After the first tab switch, storage holds one kept copy, 'The work in the project “Weeks of work A plus edits…” that this tab had not saved'. Start again wrote no new copy: keepBackup found the same text in the running copy and returned true. After the second tab switch, keepRunningCopy wrote a copy of 'New project B' and removed the earlier running-copy entry. Storage then held only 'New project B'. 'Weeks of work A plus edits…' was in no storage entry (RESULT: false). The saved project was tab 2's 'Other tab name'. No notice said the copy was gone. No outside requests.

attempts.input: Same as the attempt above, plus 3 Decisions (nav, hero, sections) before tab 2 interferes, so the 'Start again' confirmation dialog appears. Confirm 'Start again', rename to 'New project B', switch tabs, then reload tab 1 and open the Summary.
attempts.observed: The dialog said: 'This replaces your current design and clears your 3 Decisions. Undo brings it back as long as it is among your last 100 Undo steps, and only until you close or reload this page. The Studio also keeps a copy of the replaced project where this browser allows it; the Summary lists every kept copy.' Storage had room, but after the next tab switch the replaced project (3 Decisions plus edits) was in no storage entry. After the reload the banner said: 'A page of the Studio closed or reloaded while it was not saving. The Studio kept that page’s unsaved work as a copy…'. The Summary listed one kept copy only, 'New project B'. The project with 3 Decisions was gone for good, and the dialog's promise of a kept copy did not hold. Cause: in platform.ts, keepBackup skips the write when any existing copy has the same text, and here that copy was the tab's running copy. keepRunningCopy later removes that entry (`if (earlier !== null) store.removeItem(earlier)`), because endRunningCopy is not called when a project is replaced.

attempts.input: One tab. Start from a Direction, name 'Work X', 1 Decision, let it save. Fill localStorage to the brim with filler entries (page.evaluate). Rename to 'Work X with more'. Press 'Try to save again' while storage is still full. Press Undo, which brings the screen back to exactly the stored project. Remove all filler entries, so storage has room. Press 'Try to save again' twice. Reload.
attempts.observed: Steps 2 and 3 were correct: 'Cannot save here: this browser’s storage is full or blocked. Download the project file before you close this page.' and a retry button. After Undo the screen equalled the stored project ('Work X'), yet the status still said 'Cannot save here…'. After storage was freed, 'Try to save again' left the same text and button in place, twice. saveAgain calls saveNow, which sees text === lastSavedText and only repeats lastOutcome 'failed'. So the retry button cannot clear a false statement, and the page tells the owner it cannot save and to download a file when the work is in fact saved. After a reload the status read 'Saved in this browser', with 'Work X' stored. No data was lost; the statement on screen was untrue, and the on-screen way out did nothing.
